items.html: When the light of Daat ascended to its place above, it expanded the vessel of Keter and was extended through opposite the place of the Sium of all of Tifferet. At that time, the bottom half of the light Tifferet that rose up now returned in its real place as in the beginning. The reason for the magnification of the vessel of Keter was because of the light of Daat that clothed in it and magnified it. It is also because the Daat contains the entire VAK, and it is Neshama to them. Hence, because it rose, it gave force in its vessel and magnified it in order to benefit the light Tifferet to descend and be in its proper place.
